How Much is 5,000 Twitch Bits?

5,000 Twitch Bits equals $50.00 to the streamer. Viewers pay about $64.40 to buy them (the cheapest bundle mix), and Twitch keeps about $14.40. The streamer rate is a fixed $0.01 per Bit — no tier, no split, no partner status changes it.

Quick math

Streamer earnings = Bits × $0.01. Viewer cost uses the cheapest mix of Twitch's packs (100 / 500 / 1,500 / 5,000 / 10,000 / 25,000 Bits), so the viewer column is a ceiling for big cheers.
